items.title: Prospective, mechanism-led hypotheses on a loss budget
items.brief: Let new-market ideas trade without clearing the history test, on a fixed loss budget with written stop rules. That test rejected every new market.

decision.label: observables named upfront
decision.detail: Each idea names, in advance, the signs its mechanism is working.

decision.label: edge is in new markets
decision.detail: A small trader's edge is largest there, and gone before history builds.

decision.label: history overstates too
decision.detail: Merger arb cleared every test on 20 years, still overstated by half.

decision.label: loss budget replaces test
decision.detail: Set before the first trade, never topped up; other rules still apply.

alternatives.label: history-first only
alternatives.detail: Rejects every new market by construction, where the edge is largest.

alternatives.label: prospective, never acted on
alternatives.detail: Where crypto listings stopped: a conclusion with no route forward.

alternatives.label: trade with no discipline
alternatives.detail: Few trades cannot tell skill from luck; drifts into "it's early, add more".

alternatives.label: no cap on sleeves
alternatives.detail: A sleeve is one budgeted idea; uncapped is a back door to breadth. Two at most.

assumes.label: observables track the mechanism
assumes.detail: Breaks if budgets are lost while the observables look fine.

assumes.label: budgets never topped up
assumes.detail: Nor stop rules renegotiated under pressure.

assumes.label: a lost budget is survivable
assumes.detail: Default 10% of the book or £1,500, whichever is smaller.

assumes.label: one reaches scale-up in time
assumes.detail: At least one inside the 21-month trading window.

consequences.label: small budgeted losses
consequences.detail: The price of reaching ideas the history test cannot see.

consequences.label: capture from admission
consequences.detail: Records that vanish (free data windows, order books) are saved, trade or not.

consequences.label: budget size until proven
consequences.detail: A sleeve stays small until its observables clear a normal evidence test.

consequences.label: GPU rental futures first
consequences.detail: Needs daily Ornn index snapshots; its free window cannot be re-fetched.

context.label: history test rejects new markets
context.detail: Shown by the GPU rental futures idea, 14 Oct.

context.label: merger arb overstated
context.detail: 25.8% fell to 11.8% once after-the-fact data was removed.

context.label: GPU index test null
context.detail: Lead-lag correlation -0.09, n = 59, p = 0.32.

context.label: index noisy, not slow
context.detail: H100 daily s.d. 4.5%, on only 13 weeks of data.

items.title: Abandon breadth-based strategies; pursue few, high-IC structural edges
items.brief: Stop chasing many small bets; look for a few strong, well-understood edges. Crypto moves so together that a thousand coins give under three independent bets.

decision.label: few high-IC edges
decision.detail: IC: how well a signal predicts returns. Each pre-registered, fixed trial budget.

decision.label: breadth can't be bought
decision.detail: Return per risk is IC times root breadth; breadth is unavailable here.

decision.label: costs and history cap speed
decision.detail: Day holds cost 63-153% a year; 5-day holds need 40 years of history, against 8.

decision.label: event edges
decision.detail: Forced sellers, corporate actions, index and listing events: large moves against noise.

alternatives.label: ALT/XBT cross-rates
alternatives.detail: Sound, 1.6x more independent bets, still only about 2.7 in all.

alternatives.label: a bigger universe
alternatives.detail: 1,000 Bitcoin-quoted pairs give 2.73 independent bets; 26 give 2.56.

alternatives.label: trade faster
alternatives.detail: No holding period passes both the cost and history tests.

alternatives.label: defer, not close
alternatives.detail: The measurement already decides it; a late check sank tanker-flow.

assumes.label: retail IC about 0.05
assumes.detail: At 0.15 or more, breadth stops mattering.

assumes.label: measured correlation holds
assumes.detail: From 720 days; crypto correlations spike in stress, when it matters.

assumes.label: Kraken pairs representative
assumes.detail: 26 XBT pairs; even 1,000 would give 2.73 bets.

consequences.label: wide sweep dropped
consequences.detail: A founding principle, the priorless wide search, is amended away.

consequences.label: backlog re-ranked
consequences.detail: Forced sellers (H002), crypto listings (H005), corporate actions (H006) rise.

consequences.label: event count binds
consequences.detail: Whether families of events exist, not just single ones, becomes central.

consequences.label: crypto as venue only
consequences.detail: Cheapest, no order minimum, 24/7; not as a cross-section.

context.label: Bitcoin-neutral plan untested
context.detail: Altcoins priced in Bitcoin rested on a guessed correlation.

context.label: correlation measured
context.detail: 0.620 in USD, 0.366 in XBT: 1.58 and 2.56 independent bets.

context.label: costs by holding period
context.detail: 1-day: 8 years needed, 15,258bps a year. 5-day: 40 years.

context.label: about eight years of data
context.detail: Usable altcoin history; a 5-day strategy would need IC 0.112.

items.title: Live trading cannot validate; neutrality is the only lever that can
items.brief: Live trading is for learning operations, never proving a strategy: 21 months cannot separate skill from luck. Validate on history; favour market-neutral designs.

decision.label: counted trial correction
decision.detail: Trial counts pre-registered; 100 trials need 19 years of history, not 8.

decision.label: 21 months too short
decision.detail: A true Sharpe of 1.0 looks insignificant three times in four.

decision.label: big losses still show
decision.detail: Catastrophic divergence from backtest is detectable; modest outperformance is not.

decision.label: neutrality triples breadth
decision.detail: Removing the common market move is the largest lever available.

alternatives.label: validate live
alternatives.detail: Only 26.2% power for a true Sharpe of 1.0 over 21 months.

alternatives.label: long-only designs
alternatives.detail: Equities need 47-55 years of history; 50 coins held long are 1.4 bets.

alternatives.label: short crypto on Kraken
alternatives.detail: Allowed, but 22-110% a year rollover prices out holds past a day.

alternatives.label: neutral without shorting
alternatives.detail: Beta-weighted baskets: weaker but legal and available; not ruled out.

assumes.label: correlation estimates
assumes.detail: Guesses at the time; the conclusions are sensitive to them.

assumes.label: fundamental law
assumes.detail: Used only to rule designs out, never to promise returns.

assumes.label: IC of 0.05
assumes.detail: Generous for retail; lower only tightens every conclusion.

consequences.label: live P&L never confirms
consequences.detail: Live asks "behaving as modelled?", never "does this work?".

consequences.label: neutrality needs shorting
consequences.detail: Retail borrow is worst in small names, where the edge points.

consequences.label: equities vs crypto tension
consequences.detail: Long history favours equities, costs favour crypto; left unresolved.

consequences.label: spine-first still right
consequences.detail: Now justified by operational learning only.

context.label: tanker-flow lesson
context.detail: Died of too few observations, found after thirteen months.

context.label: power over 21 months
context.detail: Sharpe 1.0: 26.2%; Sharpe 2.0: 75.0%, at 5% significance.

context.label: history needed
context.detail: Sharpe 1.0 at 80% power: 7.9 years at one trial, 18.7 at 100.

context.label: borrow cost underestimated
context.detail: Kraken rollover about 22-110% a year; the model's 5% was 4-20x low.

items.title: Which venue, frequency and position-size cells survive costs
items.brief: Trade only days-to-weeks holds, defaulting to US equities and Kraken crypto majors. Faster trading is unaffordable at this account size.

decision.label: position-size floors
decision.detail: Above £2,000 on UK venues, £1,000 in US; UK main market held a month or more.

decision.label: costs close the fast end
decision.detail: A one-day hold needs about 42% gross a year to break even; five days 8%.

decision.label: US over UK
decision.detail: 4-5x cheaper; UK stamp duty costs about 2,500bps a year at five days.

decision.label: Kraken majors, in USD
decision.detail: No order minimum; Bitcoin and Ether spreads about a tenth of a basis point.

alternatives.label: sub-daily holds
alternatives.detail: A quarter-day hold needs about 166% gross a year to break even.

alternatives.label: AIM, no stamp duty
alternatives.detail: Spreads of 335-383bps; the exemption offsets about an eighth.

alternatives.label: crypto quoted in GBP
alternatives.detail: A £10,000 order walks the whole book; USD books are 20x deeper.

alternatives.label: spread betting
alternatives.detail: About 65bps and good tax, but its cost is an unmeasured markup; left open.

assumes.label: no cheaper route appears
assumes.detail: A zero-commission UK broker or better crypto tier would move the boundary.

assumes.label: spreads near modelled
assumes.detail: Wider real spreads push holds slower and tighten the rules.

assumes.label: US spreads about 8bps
assumes.detail: Still unmeasured.

assumes.label: US exchange fees small
assumes.detail: Unmodelled pass-through fees must not erase the 17bps advantage.

consequences.label: few concurrent positions
consequences.detail: A handful on a £5-25k book, against the breadth power wants.

consequences.label: fast end pruned
consequences.detail: The search runs days to weeks, cutting the multiplicity it pays for.

consequences.label: micro-cap hurdle 400bps
consequences.detail: Micro-cap attention (H003) faces it; the earlier 120bps was 3x optimistic.

consequences.label: broker plan tied to execution
consequences.detail: API orders cannot use IBKR's cheaper Tiered plan.

context.label: fees now priced
context.detail: Round trips priced from published fees, before any signal research.

context.label: round-trip costs
context.detail: At £2,000: US 17bps, LSE 91, AIM 155, Kraken entry tier 170.

context.label: measured Kraken spreads
context.detail: XBTGBP 0.10bps; ADAUSD 6.16 against ADAGBP 129.41bps at £10,000.

context.label: five-day costs
context.detail: US 16.5bps, Kraken maker 28.7, spread bet 64.7, LSE 73.4, AIM 394.7.

items.brief: Exclude only EM rates, EM FX and desk-touched work; allow other macro with a public-source trail. Appearance attaches to instruments, not asset classes.

items.title: Build the execution spine before the research platform
items.brief: Build live trading machinery and trade a trivial rule for real before research. The missing skills are operational; only a live account teaches them.

decision.label: what the spine is
decision.detail: Broker link, orders, reconciliation, logging, kill switch, alerts, crash recovery; tiny size.

decision.label: operations get deferred
decision.detail: Research is comfortable, operations valuable; the usual order never reaches them.

decision.label: a live endpoint
decision.detail: Gives research somewhere to end, so it cannot orphan itself.

decision.label: return doesn't matter
decision.detail: The first strategy only forces that endpoint to exist.

alternatives.label: research platform first
alternatives.detail: The pattern behind five of six projects ending without a decision.

alternatives.label: paper trading
alternatives.detail: Paper fills are fiction and paper drawdowns are not felt.

alternatives.label: a complete spine
alternatives.detail: Must not eat the 24-month window needed to validate a strategy.
